title: Detailed cactus in a pot
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4a7a3a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2d6b3a"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Pot shadow/base -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="30" ry="6" fill="#8B4513" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Pot body -->
  <path d="M28 68 L32 86 Q50 92 68 86 L72 68 Z" fill="#D2691E" stroke="#E8843A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Pot rim -->
  <rect x="26" y="64" width="48" height="7" rx="2" fill="#E8843A" stroke="#FFA54F" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Pot highlight -->
  <path d="M33 70 L36 84 Q50 89 64 84 L67 70 Z" fill="none" stroke="#FFB366" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Soil -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="22" ry="4" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="20" ry="3" fill="#3E2512"/>

  <!-- Main cactus body -->
  <rect x="40" y="22" width="20" height="44" rx="10" fill="url(#glow)" stroke="#3a8a4a" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Cactus ridge lines -->
  <line x1="45" y1="28" x2="45" y2="62" stroke="#5a9a5a" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="25" x2="50" y2="64" stroke="#5a9a5a" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="28" x2="55" y2="62" stroke="#5a9a5a" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Left arm -->
  <path d="M40 40 L30 40 Q24 40 24 34 L24 28 Q24 22 30 22 L34 22" fill="none" stroke="#3a8a4a" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M40 40 L30 40 Q24 40 24 34 L24 28 Q24 22 30 22 L34 22" fill="none" stroke="#4a9a5a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d="M60 36 L70 36 Q76 36 76 30 L76 24 Q76 18 70 18 L66 18" fill="none" stroke="#3a8a4a" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M60 36 L70 36 Q76 36 76 30 L76 24 Q76 18 70 18 L66 18" fill="none" stroke="#4a9a5a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Spines left arm -->
  <line x1="24" y1="24" x2="20" y2="22" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="24" y1="30" x2="19" y2="30" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="22" x2="33" y2="18" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Spines right arm -->
  <line x1="76" y1="20" x2="80" y2="18" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="76" y1="26" x2="81" y2="26" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="18" x2="67" y2="14" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Spines main body -->
  <line x1="42" y1="30" x2="37" y2="29" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="38" x2="36" y2="38" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="48" x2="37" y2="48" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="32" x2="63" y2="31" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="42" x2="64" y2="42" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="54" x2="63" y2="54" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="46" y1="26" x2="46" y2="21" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="26" x2="54" y2="21" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- Flower on top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="4" fill="#FF6B8A"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="20" r="3" fill="#FF8FAA"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="20" r="3" fill="#FF8FAA"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="15" r="3" fill="#FF8FAA"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="15" r="3" fill="#FF8FAA"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="2" fill="#FFD700"/>

  <!-- Flower stem -->
  <line x1="50" y1="22" x2="50" y2="25" stroke="#3a8a4a" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Small decorative cactus flower buds -->
  <circle cx="66" cy="16" r="2" fill="#FF6B8A"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="22" r="1.5" fill="#FF8FAA"/>

  <!-- Pot decorative line -->
  <path d="M32 74 Q50 78 68 74" fill="none" stroke="#E8843A" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
